user.title: Ferroamp Cloud Control
user.description: Log in with the account you use in the Ferroamp app. The password is used once and not stored; Home Assistant keeps the login token Ferroamp hands out. The prefix must match the one EMS reads (default 'ferroamp').

facility.title: Choose the system
facility.description: The account can see more than one Ferroamp system.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Ferroamp again
reauth_confirm.description: Ferroamp no longer accepts the stored login. Log in again with the account you use in the Ferroamp app.

error.invalid_auth: Ferroamp refused the login. Check the e-mail and password; an account that signs in with Apple or Google only has no password for this login.
error.no_facilities: The account has no Ferroamp system.

abort.already_configured: This system is already set up.
